comment: Every flag and subcommand in .github/agy-help-snapshot.txt, each with a recorded decision. tests/agy-surface.test.mjs fails when the snapshot and this file disagree, so refreshing the snapshot for a new agy release forces a decision on whatever that release added. status is either "used" (agy-companion passes it) or "considered" (deliberately not used, with the reason). See docs/TESTING.md.

--add-dir.note: Extra workspace roots for a review or task run.

-c.note: Short alias for --continue; the long form is spelled out at call sites.

--continue.note: Fallback resume for a job recorded before per-job conversation ids were captured.

--conversation.note: Targeted resume of one specific past job's conversation.

--dangerously-skip-permissions.note: The only mechanism that makes headless tool calls work at all; reviews run against a disposable snapshot to bound it.

--disable-slash-commands.note: Not used. Reviews and tasks send prose prompts, and the free /quota login probe in getAgyAuthStatus depends on slash commands still expanding.

--effort.note: Reasoning effort on /agy:rescue, recorded in provenance.

-i.note: Short alias for --prompt-interactive; nothing here runs interactively.

--input-format.note: Not used. stream-json would let one agy process handle several turns, but every call here is a single prompt and needs --output-format stream-json to match.

--log-file.note: Not used. Per-job logs are written by agy-companion itself under the job's state directory.

--model.note: Optional model override, recorded in provenance.

--new-project.note: Not used. Jobs run against the user's existing workspace, not a fresh agy project.

--output-format.note: json, for both the review envelope and the task envelope.

-p.note: Short alias for --print; the long form is spelled out at call sites.

--print.note: Every agy call this plugin makes is a single non-interactive prompt.

--print-timeout.note: Not used. Timeouts are enforced on this side in runAgyPrompt so a hung run surfaces as AgyTimeoutError with the job's own tail.

--project.note: Not used. No project selection is exposed; runs use whatever the install defaults to.

--prompt-interactive.note: Not used. Nothing here runs interactively.

changelog.note: Not called in code. Read by hand during a compatibility pass.

help.note: Subcommand help. The top-level agy --help is what capability detection reads.

install.note: Not used. Shell/path setup is the user's own install step.

mcp.note: Not used. This plugin adds no MCP servers to agy.

mic-serve.note: Not used. Microphone sharing has no headless review or task equivalent.

plugin.note: Not used. agy's own plugin system is separate from this Claude Code plugin.

remote-control.note: Not used. Background daemon for driving agy from another host; jobs here are spawned directly.

update.note: Not called in code. Used by hand to pick up a new release during a compatibility pass.
